description: bin/lib/citation-token.ts is the ONE Pandoc citation grammar (D-20-06): it reads every form Pandoc renders as a citation (clusters, locators, prefixes and suffixes, [-@k], @{k}, mixed-case and punctuated keys, narrative @k outside provable code) and reports citation-shaped text it cannot read as UNPARSEABLE. A private citation regular expression (a regex literal, or a RegExp(...) pattern, holding `\[@` or `@\{`) is how Pass 2, Pass 4, the density count and the stub word count came to see only a bare lowercase `[@key]` and miss every other form, so a citation looked absent to them (AUDIT-FINDINGS #2/#3). Read citations with findCitations / citationItems / extractCitedKeysForVerification, count or rewrite them with countCitations / replaceCitations, and report unreadable ones with findUnparseableCitations. The committed plugin bundles are outside the scope; their sources are linted.
